core_meaning.primary_meaning: Husaam is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Sharp sword; decisive”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Husaam corresponds to the Arabic form حسام (Arabic root ح س م (ḥ-s-m); حُسَام (Ḥusām)). Its core sense is sharp sword; decisive. Husaam is Arabic حُسَام (Ḥusām) 'sharp sword; decisive', from the root ح س م (ḥ-s-m). The source gloss 'Awe-inspiring, fearsome' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as hesam, hisam, hosaam, houssam, husam and hussam.
